entries.notes: The supported M2 combination (manifest v1 + scene v2 + storage v2) with a bounded content block. retry.records is intentionally empty (released state, workspace.md §9 step 1): retry-record semantics are pinned by fixtures/commands/envelope/*, and a content-publish record shape does not exist before packet 21/23. Documents the v2 canonical key order: storageVersion, type, projectId, scene, content, retry.

Empty content containers are required (not optional) in a v2 envelope: assets [], prefabs [], behaviors [], settings {}, behaviorTrust { entries: [] }. Also the expected destination envelope shape of the migration example.
Unknown storage version: one error, deeper checks stop, bytes retained untouched (workspace.md §4.3 step 3).

storageVersion 2 with scene.schemaVersion 1. Exactly one supported combination exists (manifest v1 + scene v2 + storage v2); the check runs before any scene/content field validation, so the fixture pins one error and no field errors.
A v2 envelope must carry the content block; unknown/missing top-level fields are structural envelope failures, not content failures.
Strict content validation: nothing is stripped (workspace.md §4.2 strictness extended to the content block). Path /content/assets/0/region.
sourceDigest must be 64 lowercase hex characters (a path segment of sources/sha256/<digest>).
versions must be contiguous 1..N, append-only, never reordered or removed; currentVersion is set to 3 so exactly one error is produced.
currentVersion is a derived pointer: it must equal the last (highest) version of its own record. A redundant pointer that disagrees is rejected rather than normalized.
assetId is unique within the catalog; first occurrence wins and the error points at the later occurrence (project-model §12.3 duplicate-ID convention).
Decoded-resource caps report limits_exceeded with limit: "vertices" (found 2000001, cap 2000000), not number_out_of_range.
Scene v2 model reference that no catalog record resolves. Scene and content are individually valid, so exactly the cross-block code is produced (the check runs only when both pass).
A v2 envelope whose embedded scene fails scene validation: model and camera are mutually exclusive on one entity.

The content block value alone, in canonical form and key order (assets, prefabs, behaviors, settings, behaviorTrust). Must deep-equal the content block of envelope/valid/demo-0002-rev7-v2.json (checked by tools/check-fixtures.mjs).

The captured immutable content view for revision 7: only the assets reachable from the captured scene, each resolved to its currentVersion, with the recipe + digest needed to deliver bytes and regenerate derived caches. contentDigest = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this value with the contentDigest member removed (recomputed by the checker).
